_comment: Copy this file to build/sanitize-local.json (gitignored) and fill in YOUR OWN personal strings -- your account handle, dev-PC username, school/work email domain, etc. build/sanitize-rules.json (tracked) intentionally keeps no personal literals; this local file is where each developer's own forbidden strings live, merged in by build/rules.mjs's loadRules() at build/verify time.
